assets.alt: Two business professionals having an attentive conversation beside a notebook and calendar.
assets.prompt:
Use case: illustration-story
Asset type: premium editorial illustration for a practical business networking workbook landing page.
Primary request: show exactly two adult business professionals in a warm, attentive networking conversation, with a subtle notebook and calendar motif suggesting an appropriate next meeting.
Scene/backdrop: bright, minimal contemporary networking space suggested with very sparse shapes on a white and very pale warm gray background.
Subject: two relatable professionals facing each other at conversational distance, one listening with relaxed eye contact while the other makes a small natural open-handed gesture. Smart business-casual clothes, warm human expressions and believable anatomy.
Style/medium: sophisticated contemporary editorial illustration for a modern consulting brand, carefully drawn faces and hands, clean shapes, graceful linework, restrained soft shading and lightly textured matte surfaces. Polished and human, suitable for a premium business website.
Composition/framing: landscape 3:2. A balanced, uncluttered waist-up or three-quarter conversational scene with generous white margins. A small open notebook and a simple calendar with one modest marked square are secondary details. Keep every subject and relevant prop fully within the canvas.
Lighting/mood: soft natural daylight, calm, confident, inviting, mutual curiosity.
Color palette: white and pale warm gray with deep navy and royal blue clothing, very modest warm orange accents.
Constraints: original image, no text, no letters, no logos, no watermarks, no extra people. No readable marks on the calendar or notebook. The scene should communicate a useful human conversation leading to a mutually relevant follow-up, without symbols of guaranteed sales or money. No robots, no futuristic interface elements, no neon, no handshake pose.
assets.review: Clean 3:2 composition, two people, no text or logos, natural hands, notebook and calendar present. The rendering is realistic editorial art with a photographic appearance.

assets.alt: Conversation to Client Conversion Kit spiral workbook with practice sheets and a pen.
assets.prompt:
Use case: product-mockup
Asset type: premium product mockup for the Conversation to Client Conversion Kit landing page.
Primary request: an elegant slim spiral-bound practical business workbook, accompanied by a few complementary loose practice sheets and a simple pen, arranged in an angled studio tabletop composition.
Scene/backdrop: seamless white tabletop and white background, with generous clean white margins.
Subject: one premium slim eleven-page workbook with a deep navy matte cover, restrained royal blue graphic accents and a small tasteful orange accent. A realistic black metal spiral binding along its left edge. Two or three neat loose practice sheets, partly visible below and next to the workbook, with sparse abstract pale blue ruled lines and simple blank checkboxes only. One elegant navy pen. Do not imply a thick book, multiple volumes, or extra products.
Style/medium: polished photorealistic studio product photography, crisp print design, believable paper edges, subtle material grain, soft shadows.
Composition/framing: landscape 3:2; elevated three-quarter camera view of the angled tabletop arrangement. The workbook cover is the clear focal point and occupies most of the composition, with its complete silhouette visible. The cover title must be easy to read and accurately rendered.
Lighting/mood: bright softbox studio light, elegant, approachable, useful and carefully made.
Color palette: deep navy, royal blue, modest orange accents, clean white.
Text (verbatim): "Conversation to Client" as the main large cover title, with "Conversion Kit" directly below it. Use elegant modern sans-serif typography in white, clean spacing and strong contrast. These are the only readable words anywhere in the image. Render both phrases exactly once and without extra characters.
Constraints: original product mockup. No logos, no invented logo mark, no watermark, no invented subtitle, no author name, no price, no fake readable interior text, no badges or sales claims, no hands or people. The practice sheets should remain visibly generic without depicting actual proprietary page content.
assets.review: Clean 3:2 product composition; exact cover words Conversation to Client and Conversion Kit. No extra readable interior text, logos, or sales claims. Slim workbook, loose practice sheets, and pen visible.
